title: Mutual-aid gang mobilisation times are not captured
detail: Two mutual-aid gangs from the Durgapur circle worked the event and both were released against a recorded time, but neither carries a mobilisation time, so mutual-aid gang-hours cannot be computed from the records.

title: Time to first consumer notification exceeded the two-hour target
detail: The first outage was recorded at 18:22 and the first consumer notification was issued at 20:35, an interval of 2 hours 13 minutes against a two-hour internal target.

title: Outage management system link was lost with no fallback capture
detail: The link to the Neamatpur RTU was unavailable for 3 hours 45 minutes and no manual consumer counts were taken during the gap, leaving a hole in the restoration curve that cannot be reconstructed.

title: A consumer-reported pole was never inspected
detail: A consumer reported a tree trunk resting against a pole at Mohishila Bazaar on the first evening. No gang was assigned, the report was still unresolved when the event closed, and the pole has never been confirmed either damaged or sound.
